mentions.name: Self-hosted colo migration of abound.art
mentions.description: This project migrates the abound.art application off GCP (where hosting costs $200/mo) to a self-racked PowerEdge R7625 server in a nearby colo, running on the author's own IP addresses and ASN (AS55078), including peering via an IXP.
mentions.problem: Hosting the application on GCP costs $200/mo.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on migrating an application [1] from GCP (where I pay $200/mo to host it) to a physical server (PowerEdge R7625) I've racked in a colo near me, running on my own IPs/ASN [2] and all that jazz.
mentions.author: abound
